cast.design: A gentle, steady man in his late thirties with a Manila Filipino English accent, warm and reassuring.
cast.style: A medical officer calling his team to a casualty: urgent, quick and assertive, snapping the call out with no pauses between sentences, steady but pressing, someone is hurt and every second counts. Not panicked, not theatrical.
cast.sample: Casualty reported in the forward drum. Medical team, away. Stretcher party to the ring corridor.
